resources.string: Switching stops what is running now, and the new role needs its own entry exam. Switching back later needs no new exam.
Bound users use the Key on your phone. Keep your phone online and Tadolio open, preferably charging on Wi-Fi. They cannot use it while your phone is offline.
I use my own metered API and have permission to serve my users. I am responsible for messages I send.
Reset invite code? The old code stops working; existing bindings remain.
Use random community compute this time
Your share comes from coins paid by others to your users. No new coins are issued. Users see it before binding. Reductions apply immediately. Increases require existing users to agree again.
